_doc: Pass/fail requirements for the shoulder exo. Each has ONE judge outside the design pipeline. Thresholds marked proposed are not yet confirmed by the user. See REQUIREMENTS.md.

R1.name: Proximity: covered skin 2-14 mm from the metal while following (user 2026-10-15: pass at 14 mm, aim for 10)
R1.judge: full-exo/score_design.py BAND_HI=14 (exact posed skin, 30 fps clips)

R1-aim.name: Aim: the same at 2-10 mm (the 1 cm rule)

R2.name: No part enters the body, any frame of any clip

R3.name: Follows the arm (frames tracked, not held at a limit)

R4.name: Overhead works (Raise overhead clip score) (14 mm band)

R5.name: Shoulder-chain DOF from the scapula base to the arm, counted kinematically (cap 4; the user's scapula handler is a separate part)

R6.name: No interference between parts that move relative to each other

R7.name: Every custom part is one valid closed solid
R7.judge: judge/part_validity.py (OCC BRepCheck on the exported STEP)

R8.name: Custom-part mass budget (user: 500 g for the shoulder)

R9.name: Strength at the MVP2 design load (arm gravity support + margin: 10 N.m about GH from a 50 N cuff force at 200 mm, worst direction; was 25 N.m): min yield SF over the load-path parts; fatigue (Goodman, 1e7 cycles, fully reversed) and chain deflection (sum of the parts' GH-point motion) within the 2 mm floor and the min skin gap

and.label: joint hardware at the D1F tilt (bearing static s0 >= 1, pin / threads SF >= 1.5)
fall on the elbow (2 x D1F) below fracture

R9.judge: judge/fea.py (CalculiX 2.21 C3D10 on gmsh tet10 of the STEP parts, validated on a cantilever and a thick ring within 2 %: judge/fea_validation.json; t/2 + t/3 mesh-convergence pair per part; red team: worst direction, overhead, 2x fall, smallest section, joint bearings / pin / threads (hand calcs on the FE wrench); sizing by re-solving the mapped mesh: judge/fea_sizing.py)

R10.name: Base rides the scapula on the user's scapula handler: worst GH-centre misalignment from the handler slipping over the bone (4 mm, confirmed)
R10.judge: judge/base_mount.py + judge/base_slip.py (girdle mount: literature skin-slip model, central law; acromion-cluster vs bone errors Karduna 2001 / van Andel 2009 / Lempereur 2014, lever from the OpenSim Seth 2016 scapula; docs/research/base_slip_model.md). Thorax mounts keep the three-girdle-law check

R11.name: Interface pressure, simulation part: worst mean cuff pressure the exo adds (incl. the arm parts' weight) over the MVP1 rolling-bearing cases, within the all-day budget and the ISO/TS 15066 upper-arm limits; the prototype pressure-film check remains

and.label: ISO/TS 15066 (150 N, 190 N/cm2 at 2x edge peak)

R11.judge: judge/dynamics.py (MuJoCo cuff force) -> judge/scorecard.py interface_pressure(): 7.5 kPa = 14 kPa sustained (Kermavnar; Van Vlerken 15 kPa) - 6.5 kPa strap preload; ISO/TS 15066 Annex A Table A.2; then pressure film / FSRs on a prototype

R12.name: CAD standard: G2 surfaces, flat seats under every seat, no visible screws or seams

R13.name: Manufacturable
R13.judge: supplier DFM review + quote (CNC Ti / 7075, SLM AlSi10Mg)

R14.name: Generalises: holds on motions and body shapes never used to design it
R14.judge: held-out OpenCap / AMASS clips and SMPL-X bodies (data/raw)

R15.name: Works on real bodies
R15.judge: printed prototype on the user + one very different body: OpenCap reach vs bare arm, zero skin-contact on FSR strips

R16.name: Follows the functional everyday workspace (built design: chain closes, no body contact, no part interference)
R16.judge: judge/workspace.py (L1 CAD over the functional workspace poses; user: 90 % range first)

R17.name: Moves freely unpowered (MVP1): the arm drives the chain through every clip, peak <= 1 N.m about the shoulder, <= 5 N and <= 5 deg at the cuff, no stall, no undriven spare joint
R17.judge: judge/dynamics.py (MuJoCo 3.16; rolling bearings mu 0.005; load-dependent friction; validated in judge/test_dynamics.py)
